content: Senior Full-Stack Engineer and Systems Architect with 7+ years of experience in distributed systems.
Based in San Francisco, working on edge computing and generative AI agent runtimes.
Expert in TypeScript, React 19, Next.js App Router, Node.js, and server-driven architectures.
Deep experience with PostgreSQL, pgvector extensions, IVFFlat and HNSW indexing, and database sharding.
Proficient in Docker multi-stage builds, Kubernetes orchestration, and Cloudflare Workers edge deployment.
Strongly prefers asynchronous code reviews via GitHub pull requests over synchronous Zoom meetings.
Prefers pnpm over npm or yarn for monorepo dependency management and strict symlink resolution.
Enforces 2-space indentation, semicolons required, and strict TypeScript noImplicitAny in all projects.
Decided to migrate frontend state management from Redux Toolkit to Zustand for reduced boilerplate and zero context wrapper overhead.
Selected Supabase Postgres with Row-Level Security over Firebase for relational data integrity and pgvector support.
Currently developing SelfOS (Twin), an open-source personal memory layer operating over Model Context Protocol (MCP).
Building Project Chronos, an automated crypto index balancing engine written in Rust and TypeScript.
Elena Vance is the lead product designer collaborating on SelfOS UI/UX design and wireframes.
Marcus Rivera is the senior DevOps peer collaborating on load testing and Cloudflare tunnel stability.
Believes microservices without distributed tracing and clear bounded contexts introduce excessive operational drag compared to modular monoliths.
Considers Model Context Protocol (MCP) the foundational open protocol for agent interoperability rather than proprietary vendor APIs.
Prefers concise, actionable communication with code snippets and markdown diffs rather than verbose narrative explanations.
Wants warnings and breaking changes highlighted with bold alerts before implementation steps.
Targeting sub-50ms p95 search latency for the SelfOS MCP server across 100k stored memories.
Aims to launch the public self-hosted beta of SelfOS with full ChatGPT and Claude Desktop support by Q2 2026.
